title: pseudoroegneria cretacea
intro: Pseudoroegneria cretacea, commonly known as Cretan wheatgrass, is a type of perennial grass native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Pseudoroegneria cretacea include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, making it useful in treating conditions such as arthritis and other inflammatory diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
